EmailTemplate.name: Long Running Batches Alert Email
EmailTemplate.subject: ⚠ Alert: Long Running Batch Jobs Detected
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello Team,
This is an automated alert to notify you that one or more Batch Apex jobs have exceeded their configured execution time limit in the Salesforce org.
Below are the details:
Batch Name Job Id Start Time Running Duration (Minutes) Threshold (Minutes) Status {!BATCH_TABLE}
Recommended Actions:
Navigate to Setup → Apex Jobs Review batch logs and SOQL selectivity Abort and reschedule the batch if required
This notification is generated automatically based on Custom Metadata batch thresholds.
Regards, Salesforce Automation System
